shared_definitions.temperature_unit: K in Table 2; Celsius for both variables in calibration Eq. 1
shared_definitions.temperature_calibration: T2=-3.6e-5*T1^2+0.982*T1-0.565; T1 thermocouple, T2 NaCl; T2 used throughout
shared_definitions.temperature_error: 0.2 degrees C error bar from NaCl; same increment as 0.2 K; not an established independent Gaussian standard deviation
shared_definitions.parentheses: Estimated standard deviations from least-squares unit-cell refinement
shared_definitions.alpha: Calculated thermal expansion, tabulated as alpha times 10^5 in K^-1; not independent measured fit channels
shared_definitions.footnote_equation_reference: Both versions refer to Equation 1 for calculated alpha, whereas the derivative definition is Eq. 2. This shared source cross-reference issue does not change the temperature mapping or table entries.
